name: Object Replacer
description: Replace any object (spikes, saws, blocks, decorations...) with a selection of your own objects, in every level you play.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn every replacement on or off.

apply-in-editor.name: Apply in Editor
apply-in-editor.description: Also apply replacements when a level is opened in the editor. Saving the level while this is on bakes the replacements into it permanently.

inherit-groups.name: Keep Target Groups
inherit-groups.description: Put the replacements into the same groups as the object they replace, so group triggers and color triggers keep working.

inherit-color.name: Keep Target Colors
inherit-color.description: Use the color channels of the replaced object on the replacements.

inherit-layer.name: Keep Target Layer
inherit-layer.description: Use the editor layer / z layer / z order of the replaced object on the replacements.

inherit-hidden.name: Keep Target Hidden State
inherit-hidden.description: Hidden objects are replaced too. Turn this on so the replacements are hidden as well instead of suddenly showing up - unhide them in the editor to reveal them.

transform-with-target.name: Follow Target Rotation & Scale
transform-with-target.description: Rotate, scale and flip the replacements to match the object they replace.
